Apple - Scab: Prune infected leaves & apply fungicide. Avoid overhead watering.
Apple - Healthy: Looks healthy! Maintain proper fertilizer and check weekly.
Corn (Maize) - Common Rust: Plant resistant hybrids and spray propiconazole.
Tomato - Mosaic Virus: No cure. Remove infected plants, disinfect tools.
Tomato - Yellow Leaf Curl Virus: Control whiteflies and remove infected leaves.
